name: Vadoo AI
summary: A video generation tool that allows users to add voice-overs to videos, offering various voice options for diverse applications.
description:
A video generation tool that allows users to add voice-overs to videos, offering various voice options for diverse applications.

Vadoo AI is the all-in-one AI video generator built for short-form content. Create TikToks, Reels, Shorts, and podcasts with AI scriptwriting, text-to-video, captions, voiceovers, B-roll, SEO tools, and auto-posting — all in one platform.

AI audio processing: Vadoo AI supports automated audio analysis and enhancements. Transcription support: Provides tools for converting speech to text. Noise reduction: Reduces unwanted sounds from audio input. Voice synthesis: Can generate or clone voices using AI models.
